tryIt.sentence: Um, so this weekend we're going hiking, we leave Saturday at seven, no wait, at eight in the morning. Everyone should bring three things, first water, second sunscreen, and third, uh, a jacket. It gets windy up there, so we'll have lunch at the top, head down before four, and get dinner together in the evening.
tryIt.hold: Hold {{hotkey}}, read it aloud, then release
tryIt.toggle: Press {{hotkey}}, read it aloud, then press it again
tryIt.noPolish: No polished text. Set up a polish model to remove filler words and self-corrections and format lists here.
tryIt.voiceSample: This recording stays on this computer and is used to recognize your voice.
tryIt.longPassage: So, um, about the move, like, we're moving to the new place next month, and I asked two movers, one quoted three thousand and the other twenty-five hundred, but the cheaper one isn't free until the end of the month, um, so I wanted to ask everyone, would you rather pay five hundred more and move early, or wait until the end of the month, oh, and also the books need to be boxed up before Saturday, that one is urgent.
tryIt.rewriteDraft: can't make dinner tomorrow, something came up at home, you guys go ahead, next one's on me
tryIt.rewriteHint: The sentence above is selected. Use {{hotkey}} and say “make it more polite” or “translate it into Spanish”
tryIt.nameHint: Start with “{{name}}” to give an instruction. For example, “{{name}}, translate that into French” changes the text you just entered. Leave empty to turn this off.

more.meetingDesc: Record a meeting or call and see the transcript as people speak. Speech writes the minutes afterward. Start from Meetings in the sidebar, or let Speech offer to record when a call begins.
more.askDesc: Press the Ask shortcut and ask a question. The answer opens in a small panel.
more.askNoHotkey: Set an Ask shortcut in Settings, under Dictation.

errors.micSilent: The microphone picks up no sound. Check that it is not muted and that Speech may use it in system settings.

meeting.defaultTemplate:
# Meeting minutes

## Topics

## Decisions

## Discussion points

## Action items
Name the owner and the deadline for each

## Open questions
meeting.notesPlaceholder: Jot down what matters as you go. The minutes will be built around these points.
meeting.ask: Ask about this meeting, e.g. who owns the export issue
meeting.chaptersTemplate:
# Meeting minutes

## Chapters
Split the meeting into chapters in the order discussed. Give each its start time, a title and two or three sentences

## Decisions

## Action items
Name the owner and the deadline for each

## Strong points
